messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Rescue of the Broken City

scenes.caption: A mapmaker unrolls the plan of a ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: Mara spreads a torn map on a crate beside a shattered fountain, brass compass spinning, ash drifting through orange dusk light.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns of what waits inside the walls.
scenes.visual_description: A battered oil lamp held aloft, its single flame-eye narrowed, casting long warning shadows across the cracked city gates.

scenes.caption: A clockwork scout slips through the rubble.
scenes.visual_description: A small tin fox with a key-wind tail darts between collapsed market stalls, blue glass eyes catching firelight.

scenes.caption: The glass diver steps out of a broken window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a shattered shop window as if surfacing from water, coat shimmering with reflected city lights.

scenes.caption: They find an official asleep on his ledger.
scenes.visual_description: A plump man slumped against a toll booth, ledger book under his cheek, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, snoring beneath a torn royal banner.

scenes.caption: The lamp refuses to look toward the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A twisted black tower leans against a green moon; the oil lamp turns its flame-eye away, sparks falling like tears onto cobblestones.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols march past in eerie silence.
scenes.visual_description: From a sewer grate's shadow, the tin fox watches polished boots and tasseled halberds tramp by, banners snapping overhead.

scenes.caption: Mara plots a route through the mirror halls.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a collapsed barber shop, dozens of cracked mirrors reflect Mara's lamp-lit map as she traces a path with an inked finger.

scenes.caption: The diver slips through a tall standing mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Glass diver wades waist-deep into a silvered mirror, ripples spreading outward, helmet glinting as the room behind reverses.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a name nobody remembers.
scenes.visual_description: An iron door etched with shifting runes blocks a marble corridor; the lamp's flame-eye flickers nervously while Mara presses her palm against the metal.

scenes.caption: The tin fox finds the captive in a glass cell.
scenes.visual_description: Deep in a chandeliered hall, the clockwork fox peers through a tall bell-jar where a small figure sleeps in chains of light.

scenes.caption: Rumors of something winged echo overhead.
scenes.visual_description: Massive scaled shadows pass over stained-glass skylights; Mara ducks, pressing the lamp to her chest as colored light slides across her face.

scenes.caption: They drag the sleeping official along anyway.
scenes.visual_description: Glass diver and Mara haul the snoring man by his ankles down a tilted staircase, stamped papers fluttering behind like confetti.

scenes.caption: The diver swims back through a window of rain.
scenes.visual_description: Rain pours sideways across a tall arched window; the diver dives through it carrying the captive bundled in a coat, droplets frozen mid-air.

scenes.caption: The lamp screams that the patrols have turned.
scenes.visual_description: The oil lamp's flame-eye flares red and wide, illuminating a courtyard where armored figures swivel in unison toward the rescuers.

scenes.caption: The clockwork fox sets off a tower of bells.
scenes.visual_description: Tin fox leaps across a rope of bell-pulls, brass bells crashing into deafening chorus, sparks flying from its wound-up tail.

scenes.caption: They race for the bridge as the city burns behind.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge stretches over a black river; Mara runs in front, glass diver behind with the captive, lamp swinging wildly, fox bounding ahead.

scenes.caption: Across the river, the lamp finally smiles.
scenes.visual_description: On the far bank at dawn, the group rests on mossy stones; the oil lamp's flame-eye softens to gold, the tax collector still snoring against the tin fox.
